decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed use would cause no harm to neighbouring residents living conditions.  The proposal is therefore considered to comply with adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.3.1 (Presumption against loss of residential).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted relates to the room referred to as an office on the approved plans only.  This room shall be used as an office for medical or legal advice or residential purposes only, and for no other purpose.  The rest of the property shall continue to be used as a single family dwelling house.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for medical and legal advice purposes shall not be carried out outside the following times: 8am to 8pm Monday to Sunday.
description: Change of use of one room in the house to an office to provide medical and legal advice seven days a week from 8am to 9pm
